messages:
Anya: Quick async rollcall for Q2 milestones — please drop one line: shipped / slipped / blocked + next step. Trying to keep this super short so PMs can summarize for execs. @Carla @Sam @Ravi
Sam: Search-indexing pipeline — shipped. Backfilled prod data, monitoring in place. Next: docs for SRE runbook. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Model-variant routing policy — slipped ~2w. Ran into perf regression with 2-stage fallback that needs a kernel tweak. Next: Alex (eng-runtime) owns a patch, I’ll coordinate CR today. Blocker: need a canary slot on dedicated for validation.
Carla: Console rollout (per-route dashboards) — partial ship. Core dashboards live, annotation/export delayed. Next: finish export endpoint, ETA EOW. Blocking dependency on analytics schema change from data infra. @Lena can you confirm ETA?
Lena: Analytics schema change — on track, delivering migration script tomorrow morning. Will post migration window.
Mike: Dedicated autoscale policy improvements — shipped to canary, metrics look good but we saw burst throttle at peak. Next: tweak burst thresholds and rerun load test.
Zoe: Private deployment packaging — slipped. Packaging needs one more compliance cert for internal installer. Next step: vendor to finish signing by next Tue. Blocker: legal sign-off.
Anya: Noted. If legal delay > 5 working days, we'll push private pilot back a week.
Sam: CR ping for the KV-cache commit @Ravi @Mike — left comments on 2 places (cache eviction + test flakiness). Can you take a look?
Ravi: On it, will respond by EOD.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for canary/dedicated-autoscale (deploy id: d-9821).
Carla: Heads-up — export API will need an auth header change. I’ll include a migration note in release notes.
Lena: Confirmed analytics migration will be backward compatible for 24h, so short window for exports to switch headers.
Mike: I'll coordinate a 30-min overlap window with SRE to avoid throttling during migration.
Anya: Summary for PMs: shipped — search-indexing, canary autoscale; partial — console dashboards; slipped — model routing, private packaging; blockers: canary slot for routing validation, legal sign-off for packaging. Next steps: Ravi to drive routing CR + request a canary slot (Sam to help w/ infra), Carla finish export endpoint (depends on analytics migration), Zoe follow with legal. If anyone wants a quick sync, I can host a 15-min standup tomorrow 10:30am PT. Reply "here" if you want the sync.
Sam: here
Ravi: here for 10:30
Carla: I can make it, thanks
Zoe: skipping but will follow notes
Anya: Great — adding calendar invite. I'll post a one-paragraph summary after the call for execs. Thanks all. :pray:
